_encoding.webp: v = R channel as integer 0..255; v == 0 -> no depth; depth_m = exp(ln(min) + (v - 1) / 254 * (ln(max) - ln(min)))
_encoding.exr: single-channel float16 depth in meters along camera +z; +inf -> no depth
_encoding.model: MoGe-3 ViT-G on the full source photo (IMG_6847, fov_x 56.82 deg from EXIF); per-layer MoGe for hidden (hand-filled) parts, log-fitted to the scene depth. All layers share one metric scale.

_calibration.anchor: Wendelstein summit, line of sight 2683.7 m from Breitenstein summit (WGS84 geodesic 2675.1 m, +213.9 m)
_calibration.note: near range (<~10 m) is MoGe metric; far end pinned by the anchor; mid-range (~100 m-2 km) shape is assumed
